name: National Consumer Helpline (Department of Consumer Affairs)
what_for: Register a consumer grievance against any company; the helpline also forwards it to the company.

source.quote: Register your consumer grievance through the NCH Web Portal, Mobile App, UMANG, WhatsApp or Call Centre.

name: RBI Complaint Management System (CMS)
what_for: File a complaint against a bank, NBFC or payment system participant.

source.quote: Click here to file a complaint against any Regulated Entity (banks, NBFCs, System Participants)

name: IRDAI Bima Bharosa (complaints registration portal)
what_for: Register a complaint against a life, non-life or health insurer.
